label: Benchmark score
intent: The measured score climbs and beats the benchmark. Light: the score bar rises in one push and stops dead at its new height; as its top passes the benchmark level the benchmark rule reaches across toward it, marking the crossing, and draws back. Strong: the bar climbs, stalls just under the benchmark, then breaks through to its score; the rule reaches across at the crossing and holds a beat before drawing back. The score never overshoots; the baseline never moves.

score.//: the measured score: one rect whose top edge travels; bottom fixed at y 27

benchmark.//: the rule's right end reaches toward the bar while the score crosses its level, then draws back

level.//: a data value: no overshoot. The top crosses the benchmark (y 10) at level 0.765

reverse.//: falling back below the benchmark is not a crossing to mark: the rule stays put, and the score drops at once
